## Plan review: APPROVED (with one addendum)

Read-only verification performed against main @ 90cb8d0d:

- Confirmed replication.rs is 497 lines and check-file-sizes.sh caps at 499,
  so step 1 (carving out src/replication/summary.rs) is a real prerequisite,
  not gold-plating. tests.rs is 462 lines, which justifies the new
  tests_push_unblocked.rs file rather than growing tests.rs.
- Enumerated every SyncOutcome consumer. Only four sites touch the Deferred
  variant: src/app/sync_ops.rs:126 uses `matches!(outcome, Deferred { .. })`
  and is unaffected by the added field; src/run_commands.rs:216 destructures
  `{ active_leases }` and MUST be updated (plan step 5 covers it, and it
  will not compile otherwise, so the compiler enforces this); and the two
  test literals at tests.rs:456 and tests_lease_owner.rs:199 (plan V1/V1b).
  No other in-repo consumer of the deferred JSON exists besides
  deferred_sync_detail.
- Knot has no invariants, so there is nothing to breach.
- Test strategy covers all four verification steps 1:1 and every acceptance
  criterion. The V2 git cat-file assertion is the right proof that a
  deferred sync genuinely published, rather than trusting the summary struct.

Addendum required in implementation (not a rejection):
- SyncError::ActiveLeasesExist renders as "N active lease(s) found;
  terminate leases before syncing" (src/sync/mod.rs:270). After this change
  that error is only ever raised by the pull half, so "before syncing" is
  misleading. Reword it to name the pull. src/sync/error_tests.rs:100 only
  asserts the "N active lease(s)" substring, so the reword is safe; update
  that assertion if the wording drifts further.

Security/performance/maintainability: no new attack surface (push already
ran with the same credentials and worktree). Push now runs on every
sync_or_defer call even when deferring, which costs one extra fetch+reset of
the publish worktree on a lease-held machine; that is the intended trade and
is bounded by the existing blob-size filter.
